caveats.inflation_contribution_derived: Contributions are Fiscal.ge's approximation from Geostat's published price changes and basket weights, not a figure Geostat publishes.
caveats.inflation_contribution_residual: The residual is the published headline minus the contributions returned: everything not requested, any requested group without a contribution that month, and approximation error; it is not a category of goods.
caveats.inflation_contribution_weights_d: The consumer basket is re-weighted every January, so contributions in different years rest on different weights.
caveats.inflation_target_unverified_befo: No earlier numeric inflation target is verified in the reviewed sources; this does not mean none existed.
comparison.basketReweighted: The consumer basket is re-weighted between these months, so the two contributions rest on different weights.
errors.contributionMixedLevels: Contributions cannot mix divisions and subgroups: subgroups are parts of divisions, so their sum would count them twice.
errors.periodRangeReversed: fromPeriod must not be later than toPeriod.
errors.periodsOutOfRange: Requested period(s) {outOfRangePeriods} fall outside this measure's coverage ({first} to {last}).
missing.inflationContribution: No contribution can be derived for this month: the group's year-on-year change or its basket weight is not published.
missing.inflationContributionStart: Contributions are derived only from {firstYear}; earlier basket weights reconstruct the headline too poorly to publish.
missing.inflationMonth: No value is published for this series in this month; this does not mean zero.
missing.inflationResidualHeadline: The published headline is not available for this month, so no residual can be derived.
missing.inflationTargetUnverified: No numeric inflation target for this month is verified in the reviewed sources; this does not mean none existed.
missing.inflationWeight: No basket weight is published for this group in this year.
ranking.inflationDivisions: COICOP divisions of the national consumer price index; the headline, the target and the residual are excluded.
ranking.inflationSubgroups: COICOP subgroups of the national consumer price index.
caveats.adjara_consolidation_applied: The result applies the net Adjara republican adjustment once.
caveats.admin_category_not_yet_establish: The requested administrative category does not exist in that year's classification — it was established later; a missing value is not zero.
caveats.budget_scopes_differ: National revenue and expenditure totals use different budget concepts; subtracting them does not establish a deficit.
caveats.debt_gdp_share_vintage: The GDP share is computed with this service's GDP figures; the Ministry's published share may use a different GDP vintage and differ slightly.
caveats.debt_not_budget_scope: Government debt is a central-government liability, not a budget figure: it cannot be added to expenditure or subtracted from receipts.
caveats.debt_rate_not_published: No reviewed source published an interest rate for these years - the value is missing, not zero.
caveats.debt_service_projection: Future-year debt service is a projection - the payment schedule of the already-outstanding portfolio, not a recorded outcome.
caveats.deficit_general_government_scope: This is the general government balance as measured by the IMF - not the difference between the receipts and expenditure served here. The two are not the same quantity.
caveats.deficit_projection: Future-year values are an IMF forecast, not a recorded outcome.
caveats.gdp_historical_method: Geostat nominal series use SNA 1993 through 2009 and SNA 2008 from 2010; the historical series is not uniformly revised.
caveats.gdp_preliminary: A GDP figure used by this result is preliminary and may be revised.
caveats.gdp_sna_break_2010: The GDP denominator changes accounting standard at 2010 (SNA 1993 to SNA 2008).
caveats.gdp_world_bank_history: The World Bank metadata does not specify how the earliest historical observations were reconstructed. Published values are preserved without custom rebasing or splicing.
caveats.gdp_world_bank_preliminary_basis: The World Bank republishes Georgia's national accounts without a preliminary marker, so its newest real GDP values rest on Geostat figures that are still preliminary and will be revised.
caveats.municipal_country_scope: The Georgia municipal aggregate covers 69 reviewed budgets plus the net Adjara adjustment; regional rows do not sum to it.
caveats.municipal_financing_outside_func: The public total includes financing components not distributed across the ten functions.
caveats.municipal_functional_total_gap: Functional shares do not cover the applicable public total and are never normalised to 100%.
caveats.municipal_functions_no_republica: Functional categories are municipal-only; no republican functional allocation exists and none is invented.
caveats.municipal_source_actual_missing: The required payment actual is unavailable; the reviewed functional total is used instead.
caveats.municipal_source_version_differe: Functional and total inputs come from documented differing source versions; they are not forcibly reconciled.
caveats.municipal_total_definition_chang: In one of the compared years the total is the sum of the ten functions rather than the official total-payments headline. The difference is usually under 1%, and larger for some municipalities.
caveats.municipality_not_territorial: The named code's budget is not territorially attributable spending and is excluded.
caveats.negative_revenue_correction: A negative value is a reviewed correction, not missing or invalid data.
caveats.non_positive_comparison_base: The starting value is zero or negative, so percentage growth is unavailable; an absolute difference may remain.
caveats.per_resident_coverage_limited: Per-resident values are supported only for the approved 2025 municipal and region totals.
caveats.planned_values: The result contains planned rather than actual values.
caveats.program_coverage_partial: The requested program series does not cover every requested year; a missing value is not zero.
caveats.program_historical_join: The series uses an approved historical succession join; its scope and original label are preserved.
caveats.program_parent_category_modern_g: The parent administrative category is this series' modern grouping and did not exist in that year; the spending was administered by a different institution. The amount and share are correct, but the parent is not a containment claim for that year.
caveats.revenue_2004_component_scope: The 2004 capital receipts and other taxes use different definitions from later years. Growth is not calculated across this boundary.
caveats.revenue_2004_liabilities_unavail: Increase in liabilities is unavailable for 2004. It is not zero.
caveats.revenue_2004_total_scope: The 2004 receipts total has narrower coverage: increase in liabilities is unavailable.
caveats.revenue_internal_flows_netted: The selected item uses the documented netting of internal flows.
caveats.sectors_preliminary: These sector observations are preliminary and subject to revision.
comparison.basisDiffers: The endpoints have different bases (actual or planned), so growth is not comparable.
comparison.definitionChanged: The endpoints use different definitions, so growth is not directly comparable.
comparison.endpointMissing: One endpoint is unavailable, so the change is not calculated.
comparison.gdpStandardBreak: The GDP accounting standard changes within the period, limiting comparability.
comparison.historicalJoin: One endpoint is supplied through an approved historical join, limiting comparability.
comparison.nonPositiveBase: The starting value is zero or negative, so percentage growth is not calculated.
comparison.severeAsymmetry: A coverage-limiting caveat applies to one endpoint but not the other; the two years do not measure the same thing.
coverage.debtGdp: Stock and service, where reviewed GDP is available.
coverage.debtRate: Interest-rate series only; unpublished rates are missing, not zero.
coverage.perResident: Available only for 2025 municipality and region totals (municipal.total); not for the country aggregate or individual functions.
definitions.adjaraTotal: The region's member municipalities plus net payments from Adjara's republican budget.
definitions.administrativeShare: Share of the year's full administrative expenditure total, rather than the parent category, on a 0–100 scale.
definitions.administrativeTotal: Calculated as the sum of the year's administrative categories; programmes are components of those categories and are not added again.
definitions.balanceAmount: General government balance in GEL at current prices. A negative value is a deficit; a positive value is a surplus.
definitions.balanceShare: General government balance as a percentage of GDP. A negative value is a deficit; a positive value is a surplus.
definitions.debtRate: The weighted-average annual interest rate on the portfolio outstanding at year-end, in percent.
definitions.debtService: The amount paid during the year, in GEL.
definitions.debtStock: The recorded debt stock at year-end, in GEL.
definitions.expenditureShare: Share of the year's total expenditure, on a 0–100 scale.
definitions.expenditureTotal: Calculated as the sum of all expenditure components for the year.
definitions.historicalName: {base} Original official name for this year (reviewed English translation): “{name}”.
definitions.municipalCountry: Georgia's consolidated municipal total already includes the Adjara consolidation; it is not added again.
definitions.municipalFunction: Reviewed functional-classification value in GEL at full precision.
definitions.municipalFunctionShare: Share of the entity's own public total, on a 0–100 scale.
definitions.municipalityTotalBasis: The municipality's public total, measured on the following basis: {measure}.
definitions.municipalTotalShare: The entity's public total as a share of itself, always 100%.
definitions.perResident: The entity's 2025 public total divided by its population in the same year, in GEL per resident.
definitions.programmeAmount: Reviewed value in GEL at full precision; the programme is part of its parent category and is not added to it again.
definitions.receiptsShare: Share of the year's total budget receipts, on a 0–100 scale.
definitions.receiptsTotal: Calculated as the sum of all budget receipts components for the year.
definitions.regionTotal: The sum of the region's member municipalities.
definitions.reviewedAmount: Reviewed value in GEL at full precision.
definitions.shareOfGdp: Share of the same year's GDP at current prices, on a 0–100 scale.

errors.dataVersionChanged: The data version has changed since expectedDataVersion was captured; call again without it or with the current dataVersion.
errors.measureSeriesMismatch: Measure "{measure}" does not apply to series: {mismatched}.
errors.rankAmountChanges: absolute_change and percentage_change apply to GEL amounts; use percentage_point_change for a percentage measure.
errors.rankChangeYears: A change ranking takes fromYear and toYear, not a single year.
errors.rankDimension: Municipal data ranks by "entities"; every other dataset ranks by "series".
errors.rankMixedBasis: The eligible rows mix actual and planned bases; a single unqualified ordering is not returned.
errors.rankMunicipalInput: A municipal ranking requires entityType and exactly one seriesId.
errors.rankNoCandidates: No rankable series or entity matches these parameters.
errors.rankPercentagePoints: percentage_point_change applies only to a percentage measure.
errors.rankSingleEntity: The "{requestedDataset}" dataset has a single entity (Georgia), so there is nothing to rank. Use query_debt or query_deficit for its values, or compare for a change between two years.
errors.rankUnknownRegion: Unknown withinRegionId. Use a region id from describe_coverage.
errors.rankValueYearOnly: A value ranking takes a single year, not a year range.
errors.resultTooLargeBytes: Result too large: {cells} cells, {kib} KiB. Narrow the request and ask again: fewer years first, then fewer entities, then fewer series. For a whole dataset, download the published file instead: {bulkUrl}
errors.resultTooLargeCells: Result too large: {cells} cells. Narrow the request and ask again: fewer years first, then fewer entities, then fewer series. For a whole dataset, download the published file instead: {bulkUrl}
errors.sourceYearsOutOfRange: Requested year(s) {outOfRangeYears} fall outside the covered range ({minYear}-{maxYear}).
errors.yearsOutOfRange: Requested year(s) {outOfRangeYears} fall outside this dataset's coverage ({minYear}-{maxYear}).
exclusions.catalogueMunicipality: The named code's budget is not territorially attributable expenditure and is excluded.
exclusions.municipalObservation: Aggregate-only code: this budget's expenditure is not territorially attributable to this entity, so it is not returned as a separate row.
missing.balanceYear: No value is recorded for {year}; this does not mean zero.
missing.gdpDenominator: GDP for this year is unavailable or not positive, so the share cannot be calculated.
missing.perResidentCountry: The Georgia aggregate has no per-resident measure: its numerator includes five aggregate-only budgets without an attributable territorial population.
missing.perResidentFunction: Per-resident calculations are approved only for the public total series, not for individual functions.
missing.perResidentYear: Per-resident calculations are approved only for {year}; the reviewed population panel covers no other year.
missing.population: A positive population figure is unavailable for this entity, so a per-resident value cannot be calculated.
missing.rateNotPublished: No reviewed source published an interest rate for this year; this does not mean zero.
missing.seriesYear: No value is recorded for the selected series in {year}; this does not mean zero.
missing.totalDenominator: The applicable total for this year is unavailable or not positive, so the share cannot be calculated.
publication.catalogueNotice: This reviewed catalogue identifies the available datasets, entities and series. Numerical values are in the individual files.
publication.inflationCategoriesNotice: Rates never sum. The CSV holds year-on-year and month-on-month rates for every group, then contributions (contribution_pp) for the divisions and for the subgroups, each selection with its own residual. Contributions add up to the published headline only within one selection plus its cpi.contribution_residual row; summing across selections double-counts.
publication.sourcesNotice: A document with role="derivation_upstream" is an input to a calculation, not a publication of the final figure.
publication.sumWarning: This file contains totals and their component rows. Summing all rows double-counts amounts; use level and parentSeriesId.
ranking.categories: Administrative categories; the administrative total is excluded.
ranking.municipalities: The 64 reviewed municipalities; the country aggregate, regions and aggregate-only codes are excluded.
ranking.notComparable: The endpoints are not comparable, so the row is excluded from the ranking.
ranking.noValue: The value is unavailable, so the row is excluded from the ranking.
ranking.programmes: Reviewed major programme series; these are only the reviewed and served series, not every government programme. The administrative total is excluded.
ranking.programmesWithinParent: Reviewed major programme series in category {parentId}; these are only the reviewed and served series, not every government programme. The administrative total is excluded.
ranking.publicFields: Public expenditure or receipts categories; the applicable total is excluded.
ranking.regions: Georgia's 11 regions; the country aggregate and individual municipalities are excluded.
ranking.withinRegion: Member municipalities of region {regionId}; aggregate-only codes are excluded.
